title: build breaks when mentioning "generateSitemaps" in a comment

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/stefanprobst/issue-next-sitemap

### To Reproduce

1. clone [repo](https://github.com/stefanprobst/issue-next-sitemap)
2. `pnpm install`
3. `pnpm run build`
4. see error

### Current vs. Expected behavior

with the following comment in [`app/sitemap.ts`](https://github.com/stefanprobst/issue-next-sitemap/blob/main/app/sitemap.ts), the build breaks:

```tsx
import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";

/**
 * If you need more than 50.0000 entries, use `generateSitemaps`.
 */
export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  return []
}
```

error message:

```
   Collecting page data  ...TypeError: p is not a function

    at buildAppStaticPaths (/data/Development/playground/sitemap/node_modules/.pnpm/next@14.0.5-canary.14_react-dom@18.2.0_react@18.2.0/node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js:966:85)
    at /data/Development/playground/sitemap/node_modules/.pnpm/next@14.0.5-canary.14_react-dom@18.2.0_react@18.2.0/node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js:1159:120
```
